text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: HISTORY PAINTING

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Delacroix

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The iconic image of the revolution is Delacroix’s Liberty at the Barricades.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This shows Liberty, the female symbol of France, astride the barricades, a crowd swirling around her, and tricolour flags waving.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Delacroix is one of the first artists to represent current events and his work prefigured the realism of the nineteenth century.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The French Revolution was a rich source of inspiration for artists and one of the chief exponents was David.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Jacques Louis David

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: David made one of the first topical political paintings, The Death of Marat.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting was shown at the time it was made and was a direct interpretation of a recent and controversial event.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It was also an innovative composition, showing Marat, dead in his bath by his own hand, the knife with which he had stabbed himself on the floor nearby.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Only Marat’s head and shoulders and arm are visible, his arm trailing over the side of the stone bath which is carved from a single block on a pedestal base.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The dead man wears a white cloth wound like a turban around his head which lolls on the side of the bath.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In his other hand he clutches a book or a letter.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His skin is cold and blue.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The date is, unusually, inscribed in the corner of the painting, drawing the viewer’s attention to the fact that it was recent history.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Theodore Gericault

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another French artist who made topical history paintings, Gericault is known best for The Raft of the Medusa, a very large (2 metre high) painting which shows a shipwreck scene with the survivors clinging to a raft in a stormy sea.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This is a depiction of a real recent event in which sense it was a news picture, conveying very vividly the terror of the survivors so that people could imagine being there.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Francisco Goya

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the greatest painters in history, Goya is well known for his political paintings including The Disasters of War, The Execution of Maximilian (1814) and a series of works known as The Black Paintings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His paintings are mostly small, around 150 cm high at most.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Goya’s intention was to reveal to a wider public the cruelty of war and the harshness of life for ordinary people.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was also an innovator in terms of his use of paint and colour.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Execution of Maximilian (an emperor) shows a blindfolded man on the right of the canvas facing a firing squad on the right side.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The scene takes place in front of a hill with some buildings behind it.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Smoke is coming from the soldiers’ rifles.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting depicts the actual moment of execution and was made very soon after the event.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Thus it is news reportage, depicting the deposition and execution of a ruling monarch.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Disasters of War are a series of around 30 etchings (about 40 cm high) showing scenes of carnage from the battlefield.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Soldiers lie dismembered and disembowelled on the ground, they hang from trees, decapitated or genitally mutilated.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Goya intended to show the gross cruelty of war and because he chose to use etching his work reached a wide audience that might otherwise have been able to ignore the black paintings show the life of ordinary Spanish people eking out a subsistence living on the land, living in one room.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The paintings are dark and inky, there is no light.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They show the harshness and ugliness of life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There is one in the series that shows a dog in quicksand, an ochre sand hill filling most of the canvas with the dog’s head sticking out of it.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Eighteenth century Britain was a rural economy ruled by landed gentry.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists were in demand to record the ownership of land and houses for display by the new English landed gentry !Thomas Gainsborough.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the best known eighteenth century British artists, Gainsborough, made a painting showing a couple and their children with a hunting dog under a tree with a house in the background.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The man wears breeches, a tail coat and a hat, and is leaning on a shotgun; the woman has on a fine low necked dress which is light blue and white with a straw hat.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are dressed in their country clothes, but there is no pretence – this is a painting intended to display the couple’s wealth and social status, showing them confidently engaging the viewer from the rural beauty of their large estate.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Joshua Reynolds

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another English painter of the landed gentry, Reynolds made portraits and landscapes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: English landscape painting was particularly important during a period when land ownership was the key to wealth.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: People commissioned paintings to show how much land they owned.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: George Stubbs

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Stubbs' name is synonymous with his paintings of horses which are extremely realistically painted, in profile, on a plain background.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Other aspects of eighteenth century life are well represented by Rubens and Hogarth.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Peter Paul Rubens

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rubens is known for his paintings of buxom rosy cheeked naked women.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rubens showed groups of women relaxing together, often out of doors, naked or semi clothed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Their flesh is almost expressionistically painted and close to the range of colours used to paint the skin tones can clearly be seen.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rubens draws on the classical nude as inspiration but his nudes are ordinary women.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: William Hogarth

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: From Hogarth, a British artist and political commentator and satirist, we have a comprehensive documentation of eighteenth century London life in his highly detailed drawings and engravings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His engravings of Bedlam, the notorious London hospital for the insane, are famous for their accurate depiction of a horrific place which few people had seen.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Hogarth showed the seamy side of life, the injustices and inequities, but contrasted it with images of debauchery, gluttony and indulgence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Franz Hals

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Dutch Eighteenth century painter notably of portraits, Hals’ painting The Laughing Cavalier, a portrait of a man in a large hat with a feather is instantly recognisable.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: William Blake

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: English poet and artist William Blake is known for his visionary drawings and for his illustrated poetry books the Songs of Innocence and the Songs Of Experience.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Blake made a drawing with watercolour of god measuring the world with a pair of compasses which has been much reproduced.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the eighteenth century in Europe and America neo classicism and the study of Greek sculpture was a central part of any artist’s education.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The highest accolades were given to those who could best emulate, interpret and appropriate classical Greek art, taking Greek literature as its narrative theme.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists were expected to become skilful at drawing in a realistic style, and to be able to draw from life, model and carve the human form with accuracy.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: But by the nineteenth century romanticism was beginning to take a hold and landscape and nature were idealised.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Anton Watteau

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A French artist working in the nineteenth century, Watteau made paintings of people in landscapes, often with classical allusions – as was the fashion of the day the aristocracy was fond of acting the peasant (Marie Antoinette, for example) or dressing as mythological characters.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The paintings were often portrait commissions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Watteau was particularly good at painting trees – at the time trees in paintings were rendered in much the same way by many artists, often by assistants rather than by the artist.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Watteau drew and painted virtually every leaf making the trees in his work very realistic and quite distinctive.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Fragonard

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Fragonard is known for his paintings of women and children in the countryside or in a garden.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Fragonard’s many portraits depict an idyllic life, as in Girl on a Swing and his many paintings of society women and children in beautiful dresses.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Fragonard’s paintings are full of trees, flowers and grass in the background, and the detail of the subjects’ clothes is given great attention.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are painted in a soft, feathery delicate style.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Arnold Bocklin

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the 1960s Bocklin painted romantic landscapes and idyllic pastoral scenes showing shepherdesses and their swains in ribboned clothes with the occasional piece of statuary.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Like Watteau he painted trees in great detail.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Boucher

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Boucher also painted romantic landscapes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE SUBLIME

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The worship of nature found its culmination in the German concept of the sublime, which described nature as vast and never ending, true beauty in which man is almost an irrelevance.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The chief exponent of this was Friedrich.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Casper David Friedrich

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Freidrich was a romantic painter many of whose works were painted from nature on an island in the Baltic sea off the coast of Germany.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was chiefly known for his interpretation of the Romantic sublime.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Friedrich tried to create a rendering of nature so beautiful as to seem almost like heaven.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This deeply subjective approach was of great interest to many critics and writers struggling with the idea of authorship, subjectivity and the purpose of art after Kant.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The sublime is also dealt with by Mary Shelley in Frankenstein and by English poets such as Wordsworth and Shelley.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Friedrich's paintings are usually less than 200 by 100 cm in size.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They nearly always feature a solitary figure in a landscape.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A typical painting depicts a ruined folly on a hilltop seen on a moonlit night with a figure on another peak in the foreground.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One painting shows a figure in a rain and windswept landscape with barren trees, another a figure in a moonlit garden with a balustrade, a classical statue and a broken urn.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Friedrich painted in a cool reduced palette and his many dramatic moonlit scenes are rendered in shades of blue and grey.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: John Martin

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An English artist working in the late nineteenth century, Martin painted a kind of inversion of the idea of the sublime.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His visionary scenes depicted humankind struggling with the natural world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An example is a painting of a towering dark black and brown mountain at night in which a huge chasm opened up, a volcanic eruption spewing flames, sparks and lava into the darkness.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Dwarfed by this landscape many people are struggling and fleeing from the lava flow and fires.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: English artists did not engage with the sublime but focused on the rural landscape around them and its inhabitants.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: John Constable

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Constable was an eighteenth century artist who made one of the most famous English paintings, The Haywain, which shows a country scene in which a cart loaded with hay is travelling down a lane.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The cart and the farm workers that it carries is very small in relation to the picture as a whole.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting consists mostly of trees and bushes, predominantly green, brown and ochre coloured with a blue sky.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is a peaceful image of a summer day at harvest time.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Flatford Mill is almost as well known.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This painting shows a house on a millpond by a river where trees and vegetation predominate.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Constable’s paintings convey specific weather conditions and the time of day very well.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They seem to represent an idealised and valued vision of the countryside as a peaceful haven.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Constable always added an element of red to each painting, a tiny dot or brushstroke of red paint that served to draw the viewer’s eye into the part of the painting that he wanted them to focus on.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It might be the roof of a distant cottage or, as in the Haywain, a red garment on a person on the cart.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Other British painters such as Wilson Steer, Joseph Wright of Derby, John Everett Millais and Samuel Palmer explored both landscape and portraiture during the nineteenth century.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the second half of the century the industrial revolution changed life in Europe dramatically and the rural idyll was no longer given centre stage.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Although critics such as John Ruskin held up the values of traditional arts and crafts skills, and the study of classical art, artists on the whole discovered new challenges.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Joseph Mallord Turner

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the best known British artist, often described as a British impressionist, Turner made semi abstract watercolours and oil paintings of the river Thames and London.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was most interested in depicting weather and light conditions as opposed to landscape or architectural detail.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Turner’s paintings are often brightly coloured and made with blurred brushy strokes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He had made one of the river Thames with a rainbow and one of a cloudy sky painted in white and grey.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Whistler was very critical of Turner, describing his work as mere daubing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: James McNeil Whistler

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A painting of fireworks over the river Thames was said by Whistler’s rival Turner to look as if someone had thrown a pot of paint at the canvas.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Whistler made many partings of London, but he also had a house in the Lake District in the north of England and many of his landscapes are painted there, as well as domestic interiors and portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Whistler also painted murals, for example one at Plas Newydd, the home of the Marquis of Anglesey, in Wales.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He prided himself in being able to paint very fast.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the nineteenth century the styles of historical periods were being appropriated by contemporary artists.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Classicism, realism and romanticism were broad spectrums that included artist working in diverse ways.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Some movements were more specific in their aims and distinct in their visual output.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE PRE RAPHAELITES

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Pre Raphaelites were a group of artists working in England who were inspired by poetry and medieval history.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They painted people dressed in clothes inspired by medieval costume but in contemporary fashion, women and men characterised by their full lips and long flowing hair worn parted in the centre and loose.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The style of painting was exact and detailed, everything rendered with great realism, the intention being to convey ideal beauty and sentiment.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Often the paintings had a decorative border or architectural elements.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Pre Raphaelite painting and sculpture was highly stylised and extremely popular.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Dante Gabriel Rossetti

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rossetti was a leading figure in the pre Raphaelite Brotherhood, the society formed by artists and writers interested in working together.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These artists produced paintings that looked to medieval art and legend for their inspiration.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rossetti’s Lady of Shallot is a world famous painting of a drowned woman, the lover of King Arthur, floating in a stream.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She is face upwards and looks as if she is merely asleep, wearing a long green dress with her hair floating in a cloud around her head and her hands clasped on her breast.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Flowers float in the water around her.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Ford Maddox Brown

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the British pre Raphaelite painters, Maddox Brown made less stylised paintings than Rossetti, for example a painting of a goat in a barren landscape lit by a lurid setting sun, painted in orange, purple and green.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The poetic aesthetic extended to other artists.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Henry Wallis

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A British nineteenth century painter who is best known for his painting of Henry Chatterton, a boy poet who committed suicide.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The boy is shown on a bed with a view of a garden through a window behind him, wearing a white shirt which is loose.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Gustav Klimt

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An Austrian artist working at the turn of century in Vienna, Klimt painted highly decorative images of women with particular attention to the reproduction of the patterns on textiles and clothes the models are wearing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted landscapes, giving the same attention to the ‘pattern’ of leaves and flowers, such as in his series The Four Seasons, paintings of woodlands and gardens in seasonal colours.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Klimt had a very distinctive style of drawing the figure, giving his almost exclusively female subjects a kind of languid beauty.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are often draped in decadent poses or staring straight at the viewer giving an impression of forthrightness and unabashed hedonism.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One example is a painting of a standing woman, her head almost resting on one shoulder, wearing an extraordinarily ornate dress and cloak which has a pattern of multicoloured and gold squares.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In fact Klimt's trademark was his use of tooled and flat gold leaf applied to the patterns on fabric in his paintings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also tended to delineate the shape of the body by the outline of the clothes, so that the figure often appeared to be a solid block.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These attributes give Klimt’s work a graphic effect.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another example is a painting of four women who are lying together on a bed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Klimt’s paintings often show women together in intimacy, lying together in an embrace.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In this painting the four are intertwined and seen in a kind of false perspective as if from above.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is hardly possible to tell which limbs belong to which head.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The fabric of their clothes are mixed together, so that the composition is a swirl of heads, limbs and pattern, creating a kind of round shape within the frame of the canvas.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Portrait painters were in great demand in a new social milieu ushered in by the industrial revolution and its resulting new wealth.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: John Singer Sargent

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sargent's paintings show fashionably dressed society figures, the fabric of their clothes very realistically painted, skin glowing and hair shining.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Berthe Morisot

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: French artist Morisot is best known for her portraits and drawings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Gwen John

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: John's portraits are subtle and she used a sombre palette.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: ORIENTALISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Art from Japan, China and the far east, both traditional and contemporary, began to appear in Europe and attracted a great deal of attention.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Hokusai

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A Japanese eighteenth century artist who is best known for his painting The Wave, was a master of the woodcut and pen and ink drawing and painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The towering wave in this work is about to crash down on the surrounding sea, representing the power of nature.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Hokusai worked in traditional style but his subject matter was innovative.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Wave has become an instantly recognisable image.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Utamaro

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Utamaro’s series of hand coloured woodcuts, the work for which he is best known, depicts a series of explicit sexual acts between men and geisha women dressed in elaborate kimonos.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The women and men perform a range of often gymnastic sex acts and could not be shown in public since they were considered indecent.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These works are unusual at the time for their representation of enthusiastic and playful sexuality.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Overt sexuality was not a subject of art in the eighteenth century.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Religious beliefs in Europe would not tolerate the depiction of explicit sexual acts and Victorian Britain did not even permit allusive or veiled reference to sex.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A number of artists nevertheless made work on the subject, notably Beardsley.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Beardsley Aubrey

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Beardsley was a graphic artist whose finely executed and intricate art nouveau style has become instantly recognisable.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Beardsley illustrated Oscar Wilde's book of the tale of Salome, and made a large number of explicit sexual images.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Influenced by the art of China and Japan as were many at the time, Beardsley's characteristic flat highly decorative black and white pen and ink drawings made use of patterns on textiles and clothing of his subjects to great effect, and he was an extremely skilled draughtsman.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Many artists were influenced by contemporary developments in the new discipline of psychoanalysis, as well as other therapeutic and diagnostic methods of the day such as phrenology.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sigmund Freud was beginning his research into the unconscious which was to have a profound influence on artists in the late nineteenth and early twentieth century.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Messerschmidt

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Messerschmidt was a German artist who in the 1890s made a series of small modelled heads cast in bronze, about ten cms across, a male head with a number of different expressions, often the features are contorted.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The heads are titled by the mood or emotion the face is displaying.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Messerschmidt was influenced by contemporary developments in psychology.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: REALISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: French realism profoundly influenced European art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Painters like Courbet, Corot, Greuze and Daumier began to try to represent landscape and the figure as objectively as possible.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Gustav Courbet

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The most influential of the early realists is Courbet who is often referred to as the father of realism.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Both Manet and Cézanne acknowledged his influence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Corot

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A contemporary of Courbet, Corot is known for his still calm scenes of the French countryside, often featuring roads and tracks and always trees, which he was particularly good at painting and some notable snow scenes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Corot’s paintings are small, no more than sixty cm high.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Camille Pissarro

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A French landscape painter who spent some time in London painting the river Thames.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Pissarro liked the cool grey light of London.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Ingres

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Ingres made a painting of a seated nude which is known all over the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is a simple, natural and intimate portrait of a woman seated on a bed with her back to the viewer, a white sheet draped round her hips, and a red patterned scarf wound round her head with her face just visible in profile.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It has been remarked that that drawing of the figure is anatomically inaccurate and that if the woman were to stand up her body would be very out of proportion.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Auguste Renoir

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Children and women are Renoir’s favourite subjects.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His paintings are light bright celebrations of youth, beauty, the countryside, gardens and flowers.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He painted himself often, the best known self portrait is one in which he is wearing a white painter’s smock and a brown wide brimmed hat with glasses.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Renoir’s nudes are fleshy and sensual, the paint applied to create a fuzzy, slightly out of focus effect.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A particularly well known painting shows a little girl with very blonde hair in a dark blue dress standing in long grass and poppies.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Gustave Caillebotte

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caillebotte's landscapes and people are characterised by a richness in the way the paint is applied.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A painting of men scraping and polishing a wooden floor is a well known example of his work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The men, wearing dark trousers and white shirts, some wearing caps, are on their knees in a horizontal line across the canvas, working, and the floor has a bright shine on it, created by the daylight streaming through the windows at the back of the room.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting is mainly dark brown and wood colour, with the windows and the shine on the floor painted in a bluish white.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Puvis de Chavannes

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: French painter of the early nineteenth century who made a painting of a thin young man with dark hair and eyes who is standing in a small boat on a lake.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The man is meant to make us think of Christ.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE INVENTION OF PHOTOGRAPHY

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The realist painters were working just before photography.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There was still no way of picturing the world other than to paint it.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: When photography was invented it had an immediate effect on painting because of the way a photograph defined a definite edge to an image.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In a painting the edge was always mutable and subjective.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet and Degas began to compose their paintings in a different way, framing what they painted in a way that was closer to photography.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Edouard Manet

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The French artist who is often described as the father of impressionism, Manet painted in a realistic way but used paint expressively.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet took great interest in the way a photograph cropped a scene and noted the difference for a painter, who can choose what to include and where.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet’s work began to have a new look which was at first shocking but immediately influential.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet was a prominent member of the community of artists in Paris and was friends with Courbet, Degas, and Monet.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet painted two very well known works, Olympia, and Dejeuner Sur L’Herbe, as well as Bonjour Monsieur Courbet and the Bar at the Folies Bérgères.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This last is a very original painting which depicts a bar at the Folies Bérgères night club, visited and painted by many of his contemporaries, including Toulouse Lautrec, behind which a woman is serving.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: On closer inspection what the viewer sees is actually the reflection in the mirror behind the bar.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet has taken this mirror as the edge of his painting and thus we see the woman’s back, some of people at the bar and the bottles which are in front of the mirror.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: What was striking at the time was that this was a painting of a reflection, and was not what it seemed to be at all.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Manet's paintings were startlingly new and inventive.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His Olympia (which owes much to Velasquez’s Rokeby Venus) was considered shocking, provoked storms of protests and was rejected from the Paris salon, the official body of recognition for artists.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting was said to be pornographic and the public was outraged.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Olympia is depicted nude, reclining on a couch, with her maid and a cat behind her.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She wears a ribbon choker and earrings and seems to be a prostitute.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: However it was the look on the woman’s face that was controversial – she stares out of the canvas at the viewers, actively acknowledging their presence and thus making them the subject of the work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This was revolutionary, and brought the whole history of the depiction of the female nude in art into question – here a woman meets the viewer’s gaze rather than allowing the viewer unchallenged access to her body in passive acquiescence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Dejeuner Sur L’Herbe, also a reworking of a historical painting, provoked a similar response but soon these two paintings were acknowledged as groundbreaking works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Dejeuner Sur L’Herbe shows a group of young men and women picnicking in the woods, one of the women is naked, reclining casually and staring out at the viewer from the centre of the canvas.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The gaze of some of the others is also focused out of the picture plane at the viewer.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Bonjour Monsieur Courbet is a painting in which Manet acknowledges his debt to Courbet.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He shows himself walking along a country lane, respectfully greeting the passing Courbet who carries a walking stick and wears a hat.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Edgar Degas

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Degas is a contemporary of Manet’s who also made use of the photograph in his compositions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Degas is known all over the world for his scenes of ballet dancers rehearsing, which are instantly recognisable and often reproduced in particular as calendars.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His paintings are cropped – much like a photograph a figure will be half painted and cut off by the edge of the canvas.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He mainly painted women, including several paintings and drawings of women bathing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of these shows the back of a woman with red hair as she crouches in a tin bath.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There is a blue towel next to her on the floor.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Degas made many bronze sculptures of ballet dancers, most are quite small ones around fifty cm high, as well as some of curled up dogs.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His best known and very popular sculpture The Little Dancer is larger, around two metres high.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The little girl is realistically modelled and wears a net tutu, a bodice and ballet shoes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is rare to find a bronze sculpture which has added clothes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Paul Cézanne

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Known as the father of modernist painting, Cézanne was a French painter working in the mid nineteenth century.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He took the ideas of Manet and Courbet and developed a completely new style of painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Many see Cézanne as the pivotal figure in late nineteenth century painting who laid the ground for Cubism.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Cézanne lived in Paris and the south of France in a house called Jas de Buffon in Provence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Provencal countryside featured in much of his work and Cézanne liked to work out of doors as much as he could.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted still lives and portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Cézanne was working around the same time as the impressionists, but his ideas took him on a very different route.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He had no interest in creating an impression, in depicting light, in optical fragmentation of the image.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rather he was concerned with how the three dimensional world could be rendered on a two dimensional plane.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Cézanne was one of the first artists to paint a representative image giving as much importance to the picture plane as to the illusory space of the painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In his landscapes and still lives he considered how much of an object he could paint, seeing no reason not to paint the parts of an object that could not be seen, to bend perspective, to remake nature.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He composed his paintings so that the picture plane seemed to come towards the viewer, using judicious touches of white to control the path of the viewer’s eye.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is in this that he was revolutionary and laid the ground for Picasso and Braque to develop Cubism, for as young artists they were astonished by what Cézanne had done.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He gave them the idea that a three dimensional object could be rendered in two dimensions not by creating an illusion, but by unfolding its various planes and presenting them with no relation to the actual physical integrity of the object.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Cézanne was also daring in his use of colour.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He never covered the ground of the canvas completely, always leaving parts of it bare to function as a part of the painting as a whole.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He applied colour with an abstract sensibility, for its own sake as part of the painting, rather than as a part of a faithful depiction.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He used the juxtaposition of pure colours to create shadows of other colours.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A number of paintings are immediately associated with Cézanne.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Bathers (a number of works bear this title) are a group of female nudes in a variety of poses, their bodies represented as planes in a landscape.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting is brown and green, the bodies flesh coloured.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This is Cézanne’s best known and least understood work, and it is the work which has the most influence on other artists.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His still lifes of oranges and apples are also characteristic, as are some of his portraits, for example the woman with a green face (the green representing the shadow cast on her face by the hat she was wearing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Most of his paintings are fairly small, under a metre high.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He painted the land around his country home endlessly, often making repeated versions of the same view of trees and hillside.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He made a small landscape that includes a rectangular water cistern in which there is a mirror image, many paintings of trees including a small painting of a single almond tree in blossom, and views from the house.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He often painted his wife, including a notable painting of her in the bath under greenish water.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: IMPRESSIONISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Whilst Cézanne was investigated the depiction of three dimensional space, a number of younger artists who were influenced by photography were experimenting with a new way of painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The photograph made realistic and accurate representations by artists redundant, since the photograph could do this quicker and more accurately.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This fact, combined with a new acknowledgment of the subjectivity of art and an interest in the psyche, freed artists to try to make impressions of what they saw rather than try to replicate.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Broadly speaking, the artist’s role became one of subjective interpretation rather than of objective representation.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The most dramatic example of this is the work of a number of painters working in France in the 1880s and 90s.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Claude Monet

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Monet is the best known of the Impressionists, and indeed made the painting which gave the movement its name, Impression: Sunrise, a view of the houses of parliament and the river Thames in London.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This is a small painting of the river at sunrise, the water reflecting the oranges and pinks of the sun, which is painted as a small orange circle of relatively thick paint.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This painting was remarkable for its vagueness in terms of detail, and for the consideration of the nature of the painted surface, so that the sun could be read both as a sun and as a painted circle.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Monet was trying to paint an impression of what he saw, as if with eyes half shut, and it is possible that he got this idea through seeing out of focus photographic images.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: After all the idea of a deliberately blurred image was a radically new one at the time and Monet’s idea changed the aims of painters everywhere.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Monet took from Cézanne the idea that an artist might paint what was in front of him but paint less than he actually saw, aiming to reproduce the essence of the view.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: To this end he developed a very distinctive painting style breaking the scene he was painting into patches of colour, applied without covering the ground of the canvas, using the uncovered white ground to create a shimmering effect.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He used colour to paint light as well as solid forms.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Along with Matisse and Picasso, on whom he was influential, Monet is considered by many to be one of the greatest artists in the world and one of the founders of modernism and twentieth century painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Monet made several important groups of works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Water Lily paintings that he made at his country home in Giverny, a series of façades of Rouen cathedral, and a series of Haystacks.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The water lilies series are largely three by four metre semi abstract canvases which depict a pond or lake with water lilies on it using shades of emerald, ultramarine and violet, with bright pink and red highlights on the usually white lilies.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The way the paint is applied to construct the image is almost of as much importance as the image itself.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A series of paintings of the façade of the cathedral at Rouen was a detailed exercise in and demonstration of impressionist technique.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In these works the surface of the painting is encrusted with multicoloured paint, which is visible as a façade only at a distance.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There are an immense variety of paintings which represent and exaggerate different light conditions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Monet was unique in his preference for continual repetition of views of the same subject.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted a haystack series, notable for their pale blue and lilac shadows, a houses of parliament and Thames series.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Impressionism did not impress the Paris salon, leading to the formation of the Salon des Refusés, a place for all those artists rejected by the Salon to exhibit.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It soon became recognised that these rejected artists were changing painting forever.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Georges Seurat

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Known as the inventor of pointillism, Seurat made a number of large paintings in this style, the best known of which is L’Ile de la Grande Jatte, as well as landscapes and coastal views.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Pointillism is a way of painting using only tiny dots of separate colour.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These dots merge at a certain distance to create an optical illusion of solid colour although there is a grainy quality to the painted image.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: L’Ile de la Grande Jatte shows people enjoying themselves on a summer day on an island.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the foreground is a boy in swimming trunks wearing a red hat.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Women and children walk in the gardens and under the trees and a group of picnickers sit on the grass.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Alfred Sisley

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sisley was an English painter who spent much time working in Paris.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sisley was the major exponent of the Impressionist style in Britain, painting London and the English countryside.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Walter Sickert

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Like Sisley, Sickert painted London in an impressionistic style, although he is not an Impressionist.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sacker’s paintings are all made in a gloomy palette of grey, ochre and brown, the paint thickly applied, showing scenes of London and portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Not all French painters worked in the impressionist style.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276
