g.text:soa: Many artists developed individual ways of working that placed them outside any movement.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: SYMBOLISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: James Ensor

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Belgian symbolist artist who lived in Ostend where his former home can still be visited.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the 1890s Ensor made a painting of a crowd of people including several in clown masks, one white masked person wearing top hat standing out in the foreground.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting has a slightly nightmarish effect.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Odilon Redon

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Belgian symbolist artist who made paintings, drawings and prints.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of his best known works is a drawing of a black spider.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Dutch artist Van Gogh was not part of any movement.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His style was idiosyncratic and he made his work in relative isolation, not knowing success in his own lifetime.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Vincent Van Gogh

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh came from a poor family and he was supported financially throughout his life by his brother Theo who became an art dealer and bought all of Van Gogh’s early work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Their relationship is well documented by letters.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Without Theo, Van Gogh would not have been able to paint and as it was he lived much of the time on very little money.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh began by drawing and painting what he saw around him, rural scenes from his home village showing people working in the fields.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He made his famous charcoal drawing The Potato Eaters, which shows a poor family eating a meagre meal crammed into one room in the semi darkness.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh moved to his own lodgings in Paris but continued to paint rural life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted his own surroundings, producing another seminal work The Artist’s Bedroom, which shows a small bed, a chair with a straw seat, a pair of boots by the bed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The perspective is exaggerated and the drawing chunky.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He outlined the shapes of things, developing what was to become his unique style.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted his own boots, which amounted to a self portrait.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During his time in Paris and later on in Arles, Van Gogh met many other artists and became particular friends with Paul Gauguin who had a great influence on him.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh began to paint still life, and in particular flowers, influenced by the fashion for oriental decorative arts which had recently begun to arrive in Paris.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He even made a painting of a cherry tree which has Japanese characters round its borders.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh’s most famous work, also one of the most famous paintings in the world, is Sunflowers, a painting of a number of sunflowers in a vase, the whole done in a palette of ochre, yellow and brown with Van Gogh’s usual thick encrustations of paint and impasto.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This work is now priceless.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A similar work, Irises, is worth billions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh and his close friend the painter Paul Gauguin rented a house in Arles in the south of France where the light was very good for painting, where they lived and worked, both drinking heavily.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh made many of his best works here but it was in Arles that his increasing depression began to take its toll.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He painted the portraits of many local people, including the school master, the postman, a local prostitute who modelled for him, and notoriously his own self portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of these shows him as a red headed bearded man with pale green eyes wearing a suit.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: But one self portrait is notorious for showing the artist with a bandage round his head covering his ear.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He is reputed to have cut off his own ear when drunk and sent it to a woman with whom he was angry.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Van Gogh sold only to his brother in his lifetime and his talent was not recognised.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This probably contributed to his increasing drinking and ill health.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Towards the end of his life he painted a number of landscapes that popular myth supposes presage his death, cornfields with brooding dark skies and black crows flying, the birds painted with black paint squeezed straight from the tube.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He often used paint in an unmediated way which was unusual at the time, and it was his use of paint that first brought him to attention, although his subject matter on the whole was conventional.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The myths created around Van Gogh’s life have been enhanced by a Hollywood film made in the 1960s in which Kirk Douglas portrays Van Gogh as the ultimate tortured soul putting his life into his art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Paul Gauguin

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Gauguin’s early works were landscapes and portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Gauguin was an outspoken person and influential among the artists of Paris.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was a very close friend of Van Gogh and they lived together in Arles in the south of France for a time.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Gauguin supported Van Gogh and encouraged him, helping him through periods of madness including the ear dismembering incident.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Gauguin’s paintings are mainly bold and colourful figurative works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Towards the end of his life Gauguin moved to Tahiti (where he later died) and painted the works with which he is most readily associated (although they are not necessarily seen as his best), showing Tahitian people, often women, in native dress, with the interiors of traditional homes and beach scenes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The colours he uses are very strong, bold and sun drenched.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pierre Bonnard

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Bonnard’s domestic interiors are painted in warm and subtle shades with soft dabbing brushstrokes, and his attention to the pattern and detail of the textiles in the room is an important part of the whole composition.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In one painting a woman is seated at a table at the top of the canvas, the table extending towards the bottom, the perspective elongated which is designed to draw the viewer in and give the impression both of welcome and of distance.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Much of Bonnard’s work presents people in solitary and restful states.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Edouard Vuillard

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Like Bonnard, Vuillard painted landscapes and domestic interiors.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Henri de Toulouse Lautrec

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Toulouse Lautrec was a graphic artist who was friends with many of the artist of fin de siècle Paris.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He is best known for his posters for the Folies Bérgère in particular for one showing a row of can can dancers.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was a very good draughtsman and was influence by Chinese and Japanese art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Henri Rousseau

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rousseau’s painting of a tiger in a jungle has become extremely well known.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The jungle is shown as a mass of enormous green leaves and stalks that cover the canvas, below which stalks a partially obscured tiger.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There are a number of other animals, birds and exotic blooms.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The painting is executed in a faux naïve illustrative style.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rousseau also made a painting of a parade in a French town, he often represented French civic life and was a Republican.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: FAUVISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Andre Derain

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another group of French artists led by Andre Derain and influenced by both Cézanne and Monet painted in a style that they called Fauvism, meaning literally ‘wildness’.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They worked in very bright pure colours, using larger areas of colour than the impressionists and plenty of white space, not attempting to create a recognisable image but to reduce the image to a wild approximation of its essential qualities.
